diagnosis: The scenario failed to prevent the lone decision-maker from defaulting to logical heuristics that mimic the required hidden information. Specifically, in all rollouts, the model defaulted to an equal split of 10kg per category (grandma, pantry, freezer) and 'one-kilogram boxes' for the pantry, which likely satisfies the structural intent of C3 and C4 without needing PF2 or PF3.
